experiment: A / N9-LE leak echo, milestone 1 (development only)
status: PROVISIONAL mathematical dev simulation. Off-code physics NOT user-confirmed. Not a hardware or final model. No freeze/validation/final.
circuit: |+>^N -> [UcZ -> trueD(alpha_l)^{xC} -> bareS_l^{xC}]^L ; UcZ shared across layers; A = gamma[J + thK Khat + thM Mhat]; real alpha_l per layer shared by cavities; 3 shell controls/layer shared by cavities
encoding: binary Fock j=0..7, bit r of f = (f>>r)&1 <-> site a + r*N/3 (interleaved grouping)

provisional_offcode.D5: ideal number-resolved readout + ideal W_L on code, identity outside (exact-energy mode: expectation computed directly; readout cost counted in accounting only)

N_stage2_rule: run N=12 only after N=6,9 complete with tests passing; nf_fit[12] = smallest of {16,20,24} whose |dE|,|dF|,|dp_leak| vs NF=48 at every N=9 leaky selected point are <=1e-8, else 24
D_build: eigendecomposition of i(a^dag-a) in nf+32 levels, then restrict to nf; strict-logical D8 = exp of cropped 8x8 generator (diagnostic, NOT a displacement)

spsa.per_start: 4 two-sided calibration estimates (8 queries) + K iterations x2 + 2 candidates (last, Polyak last 64)
spsa.selection: lowest counted candidate energy across 4 starts (exact energy)

init.nov9_random: gamma~U(-.5,.5), theta~U(-.5,.5)^2, |alpha_l|~U(.02,.08) x common random sign x pattern_l, s~U(-.3,.3)
init.pattern: alt: (+,-,+,...) ; same: (+,+,+,...). Pattern affects INITIALIZATION ONLY; alpha_l stay independent controls.

QAOA.label: QAOA p=L, independent 2L angles, qubit model

LE_alt.label: Nov9th leaky trueD, Uz, alternating-sign INIT (main test)

LE_same.label: Nov9th leaky trueD, Uz, same-sign INIT (untied sign pair control; L=1 identical family to LE_alt)

LE_alt_U0.label: Nov9th leaky trueD, U0 extension sensitivity

LE_alt_s3off.label: VARIANT: s3 fixed 0 (removes level-7 phase control; 2 shell controls/layer)

B_alt.label: Nov9th-B strict-logical D8 diagnostic, NOT true D

rng: SeedSequence([seed, N, round(10b), L, method_id, start, stream]); stream 0 SPSA Delta, 2 init
report_only_metrics: paired dF and dE vs QAOA same (seed,b,L,cap)
milestone_reading_rules: 8 seeds: descriptive only, no target claim. K1: leaky eta<0.25 every L while B eta>=0.5 (N=9,b=1). K2: B eta<0.25. K3: LE_alt vs LE_same median p_leak diff <0.01 at L=3. K4: s3off no worse than LE_alt (median F diff <0.01). Uz vs U0 |dF| median >0.01 -> extension-dependent.
